description: Unit tests for TrustStoreMac component, testing certificate trust evaluation and issuer retrieval on macOS platform.

classes.name: DebugData
classes.description: A class for attaching debug data to base::SupportsUserData.

classes.name: TrustStoreMacImplTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for TrustStoreMac, parameterized by trust implementation type and feature flags.

methods.name: ReadTestCert
methods.description: Reads a PEM-encoded test certificate from file and parses it into a ParsedCertificate object.

methods.name: ParsedCertificateListAsDER
methods.description: Converts a list of ParsedCertificate objects to a vector of their DER-encoded strings.

methods.name: ParseFindCertificateOutputToDerCerts
methods.description: Parses the output of 'security find-certificate' command to extract DER-encoded certificates.

methods.name: TrustStoreMacImplTest::GetImplParam
methods.description: Retrieves the trust implementation type parameter for the test.

methods.name: TrustStoreMacImplTest::ExpectedTrustedLeafSupportEnabled
methods.description: Checks if trusted leaf support is expected to be enabled based on test parameters.

methods.name: TrustStoreMacImplTest::ExpectedEnforceLocalAnchorConstraintsEnabled
methods.description: Checks if local anchor constraints enforcement is expected to be enabled based on test parameters.

methods.name: TrustStoreMacImplTest::ExpectedTrustForAnchor
methods.description: Returns the expected CertificateTrust object for a trust anchor, based on test parameters.
